verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own docs describe a webhooks integration that pushes data to any arbitrary external service. It fires on the same triggers as its other notification channels, and both the destination URL and the payload format (JSON or XML) can be customized for a programmatic consumer. A first-party Hookdeck tutorial further shows these webhooks being received and transformed by an external service. missing for 10: documented payload schema and event-type catalog, delivery details such as signing/retries, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can set up webhooks to make Rollbar push data to any arbitrary external service. Webhooks can be sent for the same triggers as our other notifications channels
the destination URL and format (JSON, XML) can be customized, allowing for integration with either your own custom tool/stack, or a third-party service
Using Rollbar's Webhooks integration, we can send alerts to Hookdeck, which then formats them for display in your team's Discord server.
